{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Check for any age values that are clearly invalid (e.g., negative or extreme)
invalid_ages = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] < 0]

# Output mean age and any invalid ages
mean_age_converted, invalid_ages"}
